Hero Motion and Action Snapshot v1

schema.title: Semantic Input Frame v1
schema.description: One input frame per 60 Hz simulation tick; pressed is edge-triggered; focus loss clears gameplay intent; move and look are normalized camera-relative vectors. Rendering never creates duplicate presses.

contracts.name: Hero Motion and Action Snapshot v1

schema.title: Hero Motion and Action Snapshot v1
schema.description: Read-only snapshot from the sole physics-root owner. Presentation cannot write gameplay state; hit windows use the authoritative action token. Reset invalidates prior tokens. Animation transition table and profile are separately versioned assets.

schema.title: Progress Snapshot v1
schema.description: Snapshot is namespaced by worldId, applied atomically after validation, and duplicate stable IDs are rejected. Migration copies original data before activation; capture/reset cancels transient actions. Precise existing life/capability rules must be inventoried before migration.

schema.title: Declarative World Definition v1
schema.description: Target contract, not the legacy on-disk format. All IDs and configurationRefs must resolve to approved typed kit descriptors; dangling references fail before activation. Validate → stage → register → spawn; failures roll back. Creators cannot access private service paths or inject executable scripts.

schema.title: Approved Kit Entry v1
schema.description: Every entry resolves to pinned approved resources and a typed configuration schema. Numeric parameters must be bounded in that schema. Collision geometry is authored for traversal, separate from decorative detail; rig joint/socket requirements are explicit in asset metadata. Unknown entries fail export.

schema.title: Data-only Level Package Manifest v1
schema.description: Published package permits only validated data and explicitly approved resource encodings; executable scripts and scene-attached code are forbidden. Paths must be relative normalized non-symlink paths without traversal; declared and extracted sizes obey a versioned limit profile. Authoring scripts may be used only locally to produce validated data. Raw Godot PCK import is not the published-content security boundary.

schema.title: Conformance Evidence v1
schema.description: Evidence binds exact immutable package bytes and validator/profile versions. Unrun never counts as pass. Diagnostics identify offending paths/fields; static checks do not prove real-player traversal or art quality. Human sign-offs are separate.

schema.title: Signed Catalog Release v1
schema.description: Maintainer approves immutable bytes after play, content, rights and performance review. Sign a canonical versioned payload with a trusted publisher key; algorithm/key rotation/encoding specification must be settled in implementation design before networking. Runtime verifies signature and digest before activation; package changes invalidate approval. No arbitrary remote code execution.

schema.title: Installed Adventure State v1
schema.description: Staging is isolated from active version. Only validated compatible packages become ready; activation is atomic and rollback preserves previous content and save backup. Offline or catalog failure does not prevent official/installed play. World content has no network capability.

schema.title: Quality Run Record v1
schema.description: One binding scenario per criterion; exact source, settings and evidence required. Rendered target-hardware performance evidence is distinct from headless functional tests. Manual quality gates need human approval. Historical renders or old reports are not current verification.
